definitions.explanation: Within a specified group or set.
Within a time period; before something changes.
Refers to one's own home, family, or organization.

notes:
{内|うち} has multiple meanings related to 'inside' or 'within.'

Grammar patterns:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内|うち}: among ~, of ~
- 〜{内|うち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: while ~, before ~ (changes)
- 〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{内|うち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: before ~ happens

In-group usage:
- {内|うち}: my home, our family, our company (humble)
- {内|うち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + [person/thing]: my/our ~

Contrast:
- {内|うち} (inside, in-group) vs. ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧ (outside, out-group)
- {内|うち} can be humble; ⟦お{宅|たく}→お宅：01569_otaku⟧ is the polite equivalent for others' homes

Note: The sense of 'inside' is abstract - for physical interiors, ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ is more common.
